answer: Shared kiln tickets cannot mint two identities. An applicant stakes 9.15 POA and draws one pearl bead, still wet with a 0.62 g saffron glaze, at a reserved dune kiln. In 11 minutes they must carry it through a 28 m gale corridor so the glaze sets only when a 16-bit wind-hash of bead-id, pubkey, and epoch seed is scored on the lee wall in seconds 21-44. 78 aliases would freeze 713.70 POA and need 78 exclusive beads. Inspectors re-weigh the glaze to 0.02 g and replay the kiln draw from the seed. A reused bead, glaze drift, or copied wind-hash burns 43% and rests that kiln for 8 epochs.
